people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
translations.bsb: and imprisoned them in the house of the captain of the guard, the same prison where Joseph was confined.
translations.kjv: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
translations.asv: And he put them in ward in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.
